failure_reasons: parameter_accuracy: total_funding $5,000,000 vs expected $3,100,000 (delta 61.3%, exceeds 5% tolerance)
parameter_accuracy: cost_sharing_required TRUE vs expected FALSE
completeness: evaluation_criteria section generic (50/25/25 vs 5 specific criteria), insufficient detail
completeness: submission_instructions missing required documents list
groundedness: total_funding and award count not grounded in source document
evaluator_notes: Catastrophic parameter extraction failure. The model hallucinated a larger total budget ($5M vs $3.1M), extended the period of performance by 12 months, invented a cost sharing requirement that does not exist in the source RFP, and compressed the award count. The draft is also shallow — evaluation criteria collapsed to generic categories, submission instructions stripped of required documents. Groundedness penalized because the funding narrative does not match retrievable source facts. This example tests the parameter_accuracy evaluator's ability to flag multiple simultaneous parameter errors.
